title.narrative: Kids Operating Room - Match Funding Project

description.narrative:
Partnering with Kids Operating Room, the wider Match Funding Project has successfully established 10 new paediatric operating rooms across Africa, alongside scholarships for 11 paediatric surgeons, creating the capacity for over 20,000 life-changing operations per year. By combining infrastructure investment with workforce development, the programme is addressing two of the most critical constraints in paediatric surgical systems: access to safe operating environments and availability of trained specialists.
Within this wider programme, 6 operating rooms were supported through the Scottish Government’s £750,000 grant and match funding from ELMA Philanthropies. All 6 sites are now fully installed and operational across Malawi, Rwanda, and Zambia. These facilities are fully embedded within national health systems and aligned with Ministry of Health priorities, ensuring sustainability and long-term integration into national surgical scale-up strategies.
